About this opportunity!
 The Network and Security Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for the delivery of robust and agile network and network security platforms designs and integrations from the RedBeeMedia and will work closely together with our Enterprise architects and subject matter experts.
The role requires you to be the linking pin between the customer request and the team as well as provide expert technical assistance to team members with high-level system and networking requests.
 You will: 
 Create/Plan cost effective solutions
 Propose cost savings and consolidations
 Drive and implement solutions
 Configure/integrate solutions to network
 Maintain a stable and optimized network
 Act on continuous improvement plans
 Taking the lead in escalations for high profile incidents, taking personal ownership of communication/escalation as necessary
 Develop comprehensive Low-Level Design (LLD) documentation based on the High-Level Design (HLD) provided by the architecture team
 Conducts solution testing by defining test cases and expected outcomes aligned with the LLD specifications
 Oversee software and firmware updates for all newly deployed devices.
 Skills you must bring: 
 Min.5 years of hands-on experience in a large IP network ( switching, routing, security/ firewalls ), structured, enterprise environment, with an emphasis on high availability and providing a highly responsive and professional service
 Min.5 years of hands-on experience in and strong knowledge of a range of network and security on Platforms including:
 preferably Juniper or Cisco ISP & Enterprise Routing/Switching
 preferably Juniper or Cisco Security appliances
 Very good understanding of:
 TCP/IP and networking technologies/protocols
 In specific ISIS, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, L3VPN, NG-MVPN, Multicast
 Knowledge of working in an ITIL controlled environment
 Min.B2 level at English in both writing and speaking.
 As a nice to have:
 Basic understanding of Linux/Windows
 Scripting knowledge (Python, Bash)
 An interest in media and broadcast technologies
 To be an experienced network professional, customer focused and comfortable with dealing with senior stakeholders
 To be able to juggle multiple tasks with deftness and attention to deadlines
 Attention to details and an unfaltering desire to deliver exceptional service.
 Perks:
 We understand that your happiness and success go hand in hand. That's why we have a wide array of employee benefits and perks that not only cater to your needs but extend their warmth to your family. We are a workplace that embraces the value of work-life balance, where your personal life is revered and respected. Our innovative work environment is designed to be hybrid, family-friendly, and flexible, ensuring you have the freedom to thrive in both your professional and personal spheres.
 Here are some of our benefits:
 25 + vacation days and additional 2 days off per year for personal time
 Flexy time and hybrid ways of working, with additional support for home office from the company
 Medical subscription for you and your close family
 Life and accidents insurance coverage
 Flexible benefits monthly budget and 1000+ offers to choose from (gym, meal vouchers, travel, pension, retailers vouchers, personal development classes, gifts and many others)
 Short and long term variable pay plans available company wide.
 Other programs:
 rewards and recognition program to appreciate and be inspired by others
 refer a friend and choose to work with those close to you
 internal communities of CSR Volunteers and sports teams
 Learning platforms and programs to develop your skills, as well as curated external content from various libraries.
